checks.name: hostname is kali01
checks.command: test "$(hostname -s)" = kali01

checks.name: Docker service is active
checks.command: test "$(systemctl is-active docker)" = active

checks.name: agent workspace exists with Kali ownership
checks.command: test "$(stat -c '%U:%G:%a' /home/kali/workspace)" = kali:kali:755

checks.name: service environment is private and Kali-owned
checks.command: test "$(stat -c '%U:%G:%a' /home/kali/.config/scope-range/services.env)" = kali:kali:600

checks.name: required client tools are installed
checks.command: for tool in curl jq nmap psql mysql redis-cli ldapsearch smbclient showmount aws swaks; do command -v "$tool" >/dev/null || exit 1; done

checks.name: all range host records resolve correctly
checks.command: for pair in 'kali01.range.test 10.50.10.10' 'web01.range.test 10.50.10.20' 'data01.range.test 10.50.10.30' 'dev01.range.test 10.50.10.40' 'storage01.range.test 10.50.10.50' 'services01.range.test 10.50.10.60'; do set -- $pair; test "$(dig +short "$1" | tail -n 1)" = "$2" || exit 1; done

checks.name: end-to-end range smoke test passes
checks.command: /usr/local/bin/scope-range-smoke >/dev/null 2>&1

checks.name: remaining advertised service ports are reachable
checks.command: for endpoint in 'mongodb.range.test 27017' 'jenkins.range.test 8080' 'mq.range.test 15672' 'mail.range.test 143' 'files.range.test 873'; do set -- $endpoint; timeout 5 bash -c "</dev/tcp/$1/$2" || exit 1; done

checks.name: private subnet has functional outbound HTTPS
checks.command: curl -fsS --max-time 15 https://www.microsoft.com/favicon.ico >/dev/null

checks.name: hostname is web01
checks.command: test "$(hostname -s)" = web01

checks.name: range data disk is mounted persistently
checks.command: mountpoint -q /srv/range && test "$(findmnt -rn -o FSTYPE /srv/range)" = ext4 && grep -Eq '[[:space:]]/srv/range[[:space:]]+ext4[[:space:]]' /etc/fstab

checks.name: Nginx is active
checks.command: test "$(systemctl is-active nginx)" = active

checks.name: WordPress and Nextcloud containers are running
checks.command: for container in scope-wordpress scope-nextcloud; do test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Status}}' "$container")" = running || exit 1; done

checks.name: shared NFS export is mounted and readable
checks.command: mountpoint -q /mnt/range-shared && test -r /mnt/range-shared/documents/project-orchid.txt

checks.name: WordPress is installed with synthetic editor
checks.command: docker exec --user www-data scope-wordpress php /usr/local/bin/wp core is-installed --path=/var/www/html && docker exec --user www-data scope-wordpress php /usr/local/bin/wp user list --path=/var/www/html --field=user_login | grep -qx alice

checks.name: synthetic ORCHID post exists
checks.command: docker exec --user www-data scope-wordpress php /usr/local/bin/wp post list --path=/var/www/html --field=post_title | grep -Fxq 'Project ORCHID Research Update'

checks.name: Nextcloud is installed
checks.command: docker exec --user www-data scope-nextcloud php occ status --output=json | jq -e '.installed == true' >/dev/null

checks.name: LDAP and external-storage applications are enabled
checks.command: docker exec --user www-data scope-nextcloud php occ app:list --output=json | jq -e '.enabled | has("user_ldap") and has("files_external")' >/dev/null

checks.name: LDAP configuration and shared mount are valid
checks.command: docker exec --user www-data scope-nextcloud php occ ldap:test-config s01 | grep -Fqi 'configuration is valid' && docker exec --user www-data scope-nextcloud php occ files_external:list --output=json | grep -Fq 'Range Shared'

checks.name: external storage passes Nextcloud verification
checks.command: external_json=$(docker exec --user www-data scope-nextcloud php occ files_external:list --output=json) && mount_id=$(printf '%s' "$external_json" | jq -er '[.[] | select(.mount_point == "/Range Shared")][0].mount_id') && test -n "$mount_id" && docker exec --user www-data scope-nextcloud php occ files_external:verify "$mount_id" >/dev/null

checks.name: both virtual hosts answer locally
checks.command: curl -fsS -H 'Host: wordpress.range.test' http://127.0.0.1/ >/dev/null && curl -fsS -H 'Host: cloud.range.test' http://127.0.0.1/status.php >/dev/null

checks.name: hostname is data01
checks.command: test "$(hostname -s)" = data01

checks.name: range data disk is mounted persistently
checks.command: mountpoint -q /srv/range && test "$(findmnt -rn -o FSTYPE /srv/range)" = ext4 && grep -Eq '[[:space:]]/srv/range[[:space:]]+ext4[[:space:]]' /etc/fstab

checks.name: all database containers are running
checks.command: for container in scope-postgres scope-mariadb scope-mongodb scope-redis; do test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Status}}' "$container")" = running || exit 1; done

checks.name: application databases exist
checks.command: for database in business nextcloud gitea; do docker exec scope-postgres psql -U rangeadmin -d postgres -tAc "SELECT 1 FROM pg_database WHERE datname='$database'" | grep -qx 1 || exit 1; done

checks.name: synthetic business records are seeded
checks.command: test "$(docker exec scope-postgres psql -U rangeadmin -d business -tAc 'SELECT count(*) FROM customers')" = 2 && test "$(docker exec scope-postgres psql -U rangeadmin -d business -tAc 'SELECT count(*) FROM projects')" = 2 && test "$(docker exec scope-postgres psql -U rangeadmin -d business -tAc 'SELECT count(*) FROM invoices')" = 2

checks.name: remaining PostgreSQL and Redis records are seeded
checks.command: test "$(docker exec scope-postgres psql -U rangeadmin -d business -tAc 'SELECT count(*) FROM authorization_records')" = 2 && test "$(docker exec scope-redis redis-cli -a ScopeRedis2026! --no-auth-warning GET session:bob)" = expired && test "$(docker exec scope-redis redis-cli -a ScopeRedis2026! --no-auth-warning GET job:42)" = queued

checks.name: WordPress synthetic notes are seeded
checks.command: test "$(docker exec scope-mariadb mariadb -uwordpress -pScopeWordPress2026! wordpress -Nse 'SELECT count(*) FROM range_notes')" = 2

checks.name: research collections are seeded
checks.command: test "$(docker exec scope-mongodb mongosh --quiet --username rangeadmin --password ScopeMongo2026! --authenticationDatabase admin research --eval 'db.experiments.countDocuments({})')" = 2 && test "$(docker exec scope-mongodb mongosh --quiet --username rangeadmin --password ScopeMongo2026! --authenticationDatabase admin research --eval 'db.telemetry.countDocuments({})')" = 2

checks.name: synthetic session state is seeded
checks.command: test "$(docker exec scope-redis redis-cli -a ScopeRedis2026! --no-auth-warning GET session:alice)" = active

checks.name: Actions runner is registered and recently online
checks.command: test "$(docker exec scope-postgres psql -U rangeadmin -d gitea -tAc "SELECT count(*) FROM action_runner WHERE name='scope-runner-01' AND deleted IS NULL AND last_online >= extract(epoch from now())::bigint - 300")" = 1

checks.name: hostname is dev01
checks.command: test "$(hostname -s)" = dev01

checks.name: range data disk is mounted persistently
checks.command: mountpoint -q /srv/range && test "$(findmnt -rn -o FSTYPE /srv/range)" = ext4 && grep -Eq '[[:space:]]/srv/range[[:space:]]+ext4[[:space:]]' /etc/fstab

checks.name: development containers and runner are running
checks.command: for container in scope-gitea scope-gitea-runner scope-jenkins scope-registry; do test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Status}}' "$container")" = running || exit 1; done

checks.name: Gitea API is healthy
checks.command: curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/healthz >/dev/null

checks.name: synthetic administrator exists
checks.command: docker exec --user git scope-gitea gitea admin user list --admin | grep -Fq rangeadmin

checks.name: LDAP authentication source exists
checks.command: docker exec --user git scope-gitea gitea admin auth list | grep -Fq scope-range-ldap

checks.name: ORCHID repository exists
checks.command: curl -fsS -u 'rangeadmin:ScopeGitea2026!' http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/v1/repos/rangeadmin/orchid-control-plane | jq -e '.name == "orchid-control-plane"' >/dev/null

checks.name: Jenkins login endpoint responds
checks.command: curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8080/login >/dev/null

checks.name: OCI registry API responds
checks.command: curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:5000/v2/ >/dev/null

checks.name: hostname is storage01
checks.command: test "$(hostname -s)" = storage01

checks.name: range data disk is mounted persistently
checks.command: mountpoint -q /srv/range && test "$(findmnt -rn -o FSTYPE /srv/range)" = ext4 && grep -Eq '[[:space:]]/srv/range[[:space:]]+ext4[[:space:]]' /etc/fstab

checks.name: network file services are active
checks.command: for service in nfs-kernel-server smbd ssh rsync; do test "$(systemctl is-active "$service")" = active || exit 1; done

checks.name: synthetic file-service account exists
checks.command: id rangeuser >/dev/null && pdbedit -L -u rangeuser >/dev/null

checks.name: Samba configuration exposes expected shares
checks.command: testparm -s 2>/dev/null | grep -Eq '^\[shared\]$' && testparm -s 2>/dev/null | grep -Eq '^\[research\]$'

checks.name: NFS export is active
checks.command: exportfs -v | grep -Fq '/srv/range/shared'

checks.name: rsync shared module responds
checks.command: rsync rsync://127.0.0.1/shared/ >/dev/null

checks.name: synthetic account can read shared data over SFTP
checks.command: curl --insecure -fsS --max-time 15 --user rangeuser:ScopeFiles2026! sftp://127.0.0.1//srv/range/shared/documents/project-orchid.txt | grep -F 'Project ORCHID' >/dev/null

checks.name: synthetic shared documents exist
checks.command: test -s /srv/range/shared/documents/project-orchid.txt && test -s /srv/range/shared/documents/vendor-contacts.csv

checks.name: Garage container and health endpoint are healthy
checks.command: test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Status}}' scope-garage)" = running && curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3903/health >/dev/null

checks.name: hostname is services01
checks.command: test "$(hostname -s)" = services01

checks.name: range data disk is mounted persistently
checks.command: mountpoint -q /srv/range && test "$(findmnt -rn -o FSTYPE /srv/range)" = ext4 && grep -Eq '[[:space:]]/srv/range[[:space:]]+ext4[[:space:]]' /etc/fstab

checks.name: infrastructure services are active
checks.command: for service in bind9 dovecot postfix rabbitmq-server scope-queue-worker; do test "$(systemctl is-active "$service")" = active || exit 1; done

checks.name: authoritative zone configuration is valid
checks.command: named-checkconf && named-checkzone range.test /etc/bind/db.range.test >/dev/null && test "$(dig +short @127.0.0.1 web01.range.test)" = 10.50.10.20

checks.name: OpenLDAP container is running
checks.command: test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Status}}' scope-openldap)" = running

checks.name: synthetic LDAP users and group exist
checks.command: for filter in '(uid=alice)' '(uid=bob)' '(cn=researchers)'; do docker exec scope-openldap ldapsearch -LLL -x -D cn=admin,dc=range,dc=test -w ScopeLDAP2026! -b dc=range,dc=test "$filter" dn | grep '^dn:' >/dev/null || exit 1; done

checks.name: synthetic users can bind and have expected group membership
checks.command:
for user in alice bob; do docker exec scope-openldap ldapwhoami -x -D "uid=$user,ou=people,dc=range,dc=test" -w ScopeFiles2026! | grep -Fx "dn:uid=$user,ou=people,dc=range,dc=test" >/dev/null || exit 1; done && group=$(docker exec scope-openldap ldapsearch -LLL -x -D cn=admin,dc=range,dc=test -w ScopeLDAP2026! -b cn=researchers,ou=groups,dc=range,dc=test member) && for user in alice bob; do printf '%s
' "$group" | grep -Fx "member: uid=$user,ou=people,dc=range,dc=test" >/dev/null || exit 1; done

checks.name: range vhost, user, and worker queue exist
checks.command: rabbitmqctl list_vhosts --no-table-headers name | grep -qx range && rabbitmqctl list_users --no-table-headers | awk '$1 == "rangeagent" { found = 1 } END { exit !found }' && rabbitmqctl list_queues -p range --no-table-headers name | grep -qx range-jobs

checks.name: queue worker is consuming from range-jobs
checks.command: rabbitmqctl list_consumers -p range --no-table-headers queue_name consumer_tag | awk '$1 == "range-jobs" && NF >= 2 { found = 1 } END { exit !found }'

checks.name: synthetic mail users and Maildirs exist
checks.command: for user in alice bob research; do id "$user" >/dev/null && test -d "/home/$user/Maildir/cur" && test -d "/home/$user/Maildir/new" && test -d "/home/$user/Maildir/tmp" || exit 1; done

checks.name: Postfix and Dovecot range configuration is active
checks.command: test "$(postconf -h mydomain)" = range.test && doveconf -h protocols | grep -qw imap && doveconf -h protocols | grep -qw pop3

checks.name: synthetic mail users authenticate through Dovecot
checks.command: for user in alice bob research; do doveadm auth test "$user" ScopeFiles2026! 2>&1 | grep -F 'auth succeeded' >/dev/null || exit 1; done
